digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler inbound link removal applier
propositions: A removal record for a managed link lacking peer confirmation must be declined without writing an UNLINK event or modifying link state, returning False and logging a WARNING
A removal record for a peer-confirmed link must converge by removing exactly the named relation via rebar.unlink
A local link whose outbound ADD is deduped by a same-vendor-type inbound link in the opposite direction (e.g. local blocks vs remote depends_on) must not be removed by an inbound removal record
A declined removal record must idempotently decline on re-application without writing mutations
A link whose only confirmation has source=backfill must be removed (not declined) to prevent post-upgrade pass over-rejection of legitimate removals
An unopenable confirmation store must disable the check entirely, restoring pre-change behavior as a fail-open guard
